description: Runs IRS Publication 590-A Worksheet 1-2 (the deductible part of a traditional IRA contribution when you or your spouse is covered by a plan at work) and Worksheet 2-2 (the reduced Roth IRA contribution limit) for 2026 or 2027 on a given modified AGI, line by line, with the age-50 catch-up, the compensation cap, the spousal IRA rule and the worksheets' rounding and minimum; returns the deductible and nondeductible parts of a traditional contribution, the Roth IRA limit and the Roth room left. The limits and ranges are the website's IRA and Roth income-limit pages' own figures (the 2027 limit and ranges are projections under the statutory indexing formula until the IRS publishes them, labelled as such). Not tax advice.

age.description: Your age on December 31 of the tax year (18-110): 50 or older adds the catch-up.

amount.description: The contribution for the year. Default: your full limit.

contribution_type.description: traditional (default): the deductible and nondeductible parts of the contribution. roth: your Roth IRA limit at this MAGI.

covered.description: You are covered by a retirement plan at work (the W-2 'Retirement plan' box). Default false.

filing_status.description: single, mfj, hoh, mfs (lived with the spouse at some time in the year) or mfs_apart (married filing separately, lived apart all year: treated as unmarried).

magi.description: Modified AGI: the income the worksheets run on.

spouse_covered.description: mfj or mfs: your spouse is covered by a plan at work. Default false.

spouse_ira_contributions.description: Joint return only: the spouse's own IRA contributions (the spousal IRA rule). Default 0.

spouse_wages.description: Joint return only: the spouse's wages. Default 0.

tax_year.description: 2026 (default) or 2027. 2027: the limits and phase-out ranges are the 2027 pages' PROJECTIONS under each limit's statutory indexing formula (the IRS's 2027 retirement-plan limits notice is not out yet), labelled as such. Stated in the result.

wages.description: Your wages (W-2 box 1): your compensation, which caps the contribution. Default: the MAGI is taken as your compensation.

name: ira_deduction_and_roth_limit
title: Traditional IRA deduction and Roth IRA limit at a modified AGI (2026; 2027 ranges projected)
